t: This is the memorial stone to PC Keith Palmer. Palmer was a London police constable who died in the Westminster attack in 2017. Though unarmed, he stopped a knife-wielding attacker from entering the Palace of Westminster, and he was fatally wounded. He was posthumously awarded the George Medal, the second-highest award for gallantry not in the face of the enemy. He had served with the Metropolitan Police for sixteen years, and had joined its Parliamentary and Diplomatic Protection Group in April 2016. He lived from 1969 to 2017.
